item.title: Orosur extends shallow high-grade gold zone at Pepas West
item.summary: Orosur Mining has reported six further drill holes at its Pepas West prospect in Colombia, confirming an extensive, flat-lying zone of shallow, high-grade gold that the company sees as a priority for near-term production.
